description: Event Title: CyberQuest'26 by Cyber Space Club About the Competition: NATIONAL LEVEL — OUTSTATION TEAMS ONLY Get ready to test your cybersecurity skills, problem-solving abilities, and technical knowledge at CyberQuest 2026 , a multi-round offline cybersecurity competition organized by Cyber Space Club, Manipal University Jaipur . The competition is exclusively open to students from colleges and universities across India, excluding students of Manipal University Jaipur . From identifying vulnerabilities to solving CTF challenges and cracking cryptic cyber puzzles, CyberQuest'26 is designed for cybersecurity enthusiasts who are ready to learn, analyze, exploit, and investigate . Form your team, travel to Manipal University Jaipur, compete across multiple challenging rounds, and prove your cybersecurity skills against teams from across the country. Competition Structure: Round 0 — Cybersecurity Masterclass Learn essential cybersecurity concepts, techniques, and approaches before taking on the challenges. Round 1 — Vulnerability Hunt Identify, analyze, and exploit vulnerabilities through practical cybersecurity challenges. Round 2 — Cyber CTF Put your technical skills to the test through hands-on Capture the Flag challenges. Round 3 — Cryptic Cyber Hunt Solve cryptic clues, puzzles, and cybersecurity-based challenges to reach the finish. Event Details: Mode: Offline Venue: Manipal University Jaipur, Rajasthan Dates: 9th–11th October 2026 Round 0 & Round 1: 9th October 2026 Round 2: 10th October 2026 Round 3: 11th October 2026 Team Size: 1–4 Members Registration Fee : 299/- Prize Pool: ₹50,000 Level: National-Level Organizer: Cyber Space Club, Manipal University Jaipur Eligibility: Open to students enrolled in colleges and universities across India . Only outstation teams are eligible to participate. Participants may form teams of 1–4 members . All team members must be eligible students at the time of registration. Food & Accommodation: Food and accommodation facilities

raw.details:
Event Title:

  • CyberQuest'26 by Cyber Space Club

About the Competition:

  • NATIONAL LEVEL — OUTSTATION TEAMS ONLY
  • Get ready to test your cybersecurity skills, problem-solving abilities, and technical knowledge at CyberQuest 2026, a multi-round offline cybersecurity competition organized by Cyber Space Club, Manipal University Jaipur.
  • The competition is exclusively open to students from colleges and universities across India, excluding students of Manipal University Jaipur.
  • From identifying vulnerabilities to solving CTF challenges and cracking cryptic cyber puzzles, CyberQuest'26 is designed for cybersecurity enthusiasts who are ready to learn, analyze, exploit, and investigate.
  • Form your team, travel to Manipal University Jaipur, compete across multiple challenging rounds, and prove your cybersecurity skills against teams from across the country.

Competition Structure:

  • Round 0 — Cybersecurity Masterclass
    • Learn essential cybersecurity concepts, techniques, and approaches before taking on the challenges.
  • Round 1 — Vulnerability Hunt
    • Identify, analyze, and exploit vulnerabilities through practical cybersecurity challenges.
  • Round 2 — Cyber CTF
    • Put your technical skills to the test through hands-on Capture the Flag challenges.
  • Round 3 — Cryptic Cyber Hunt
    • Solve cryptic clues, puzzles, and cybersecurity-based challenges to reach the finish.

Event Details:

  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: Manipal University Jaipur, Rajasthan
  • Dates: 9th–11th October 2026
  • Round 0 & Round 1: 9th October 2026
  • Round 2: 10th October 2026
  • Round 3: 11th October 2026
  • Team Size: 1–4 Members
  • Registration Fee: 299/-
  • Prize Pool: ₹50,000
  • Level: National-Level
  • Organizer: Cyber Space Club, Manipal University Jaipur

Eligibility:

  • Open to students enrolled in colleges and universities across India.
  • Only outstation teams are eligible to participate.
  • Participants may form teams of 1–4 members.
  • All team members must be eligible students at the time of registration.

Food & Accommodation:

  • Food and accommodation facilities will be available on a chargeable basis, subject to availability.
  • Participants interested in accommodation are advised to submit their requirements in advance.
  • Charges and availability will be communicated to eligible participants by the organizing team.

About:

  • ₹50,000 Prize Pool
  • Manipal University Jaipur
  • 9th–11th October 2026
  • National-Level | Outstation Teams Only

NOTE:

  • CyberQuest'26 is an offline, national-level competition exclusively for outstation participants. All eligible teams must travel to Manipal University Jaipur to participate in the competition rounds.
